fields.statement: At 769366365, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestHealthMainOrphanLog' passes (TestHealthMainOrphanLog, TestHealthMainOrphanLogLiveRun). Read the tests: an orphan entry makes healthMain bad with Next 'rhiza model commit-untracked' and detail naming .rhiza/log/<cs>/ and the change set; a stale close-out never softens the orphan's bad; after daemonCommitUntracked the entry is held by a model branch and the part is ok with a 'pending entry' detail; an entry a live run's worktree holds leaves the part ok with the pending entry listed and no 'on no branch'; and the new case (Decision orphan-log-needs-origin-main, the confirmed cycle-2 finding) uses modelBranchFixture(t,false) and asserts an untracked entry with no origin/main leaves the part ok with no Next and no orphan or commit-untracked detail. Testscripts run-start-new-main-clean, health*, check-orphan-log and model-commit-untracked pass (an earlier run-start-new-main-clean failure was my own $WORK path containing 'orphan', gone with a neutral TMPDIR). internal/api -run 'Health|ModelBranch|CommitUntracked|Orphan|Untracked|Check' passes; the only FAIL line was the root-state guard on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live daemon rewrites.
